name: Song Mountain
operator: Intermountain Management (also operates Labrador Mountain; the two are marketed together as SkiCNY)

source.note: Search summary (2026-09-30; attribution between Snow-Forecast and SkiCentral not isolated): 100 acres, 24 trails, 5 lifts = 2 chairlifts and 3 surface lifts.

character: The larger of the two SkiCNY ski areas, set beside I-81 south of Syracuse; it shares an operator and a combined season pass with Labrador Mountain. Its on-site restaurant is Heuga's Alpine.

season.notes: OnTheSnow projects Dec 12, 2026 for 2026-27 (a third-party projection, not an announcement; checked 2026-09-30). No 2026-27 opening date and no historical opening dates found in research. 2026-27 SkiCNY season passes (valid at Song and Labrador, '2 mountains for 1 price') went on sale in spring 2026; spring pricing ran through Wed Apr 15, 2026 with a Buddy Pass and a $25 voucher for Heuga's Alpine; an 'Early Fall 2026-27' rate page exists. After Toggenburg closed in 2021, reporting described longer lift lines at Song. The operator lost a NY antitrust case in 2025 over buying and closing Toggenburg; remedies were pending as of Aug 2025.

prices.note: SkiCNY 2025-26 daily rate, valid at Song and Labrador (4-hour adult ticket $84). Day-type rules not stated. 2026-27 rates not found.

research.confidenceNotes: Updated 2026-09-30: vertical (700 ft), terrain (24 trails, 100 acres, 5 lifts = 2 chairs + 3 surface) and the 2025-26 SkiCNY adult rate come from search summaries. The web-search budget ran out before Song-specific searches could run, so this record is mostly unknowns. Included facts come from shared SkiCNY and ownership sources: the Intermountain operator, the combined Song+Labrador 2026-27 pass and the Heuga's Alpine restaurant. Stats were deliberately left null rather than filled from memory. Coordinates are approximate estimates for weather-model use only; drive time is a Piste estimate.
